LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 3.3.1 WORD CLASSES: PRIMARY AUXILIARIES

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.3: Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries, part of Strand 3 in Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: What are the functions of verbs in sentences?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. identify primary auxiliary verbs from a text,

2. search for the functions of primary auxiliary verbs from the internet or text books,

3. individually write down sentences using each of the primary auxiliary verbs identified,

4. collaborate to write a short paragraph on environmental conservation using primary auxiliary verbs,

5. read out the paragraphs to the rest of the class,

6. fill in blank spaces in sentences given using the correct form of the primary auxiliary verbs,

7. engage in a question and answer session using primary auxiliary verbs.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. identify primary auxiliary verbs from a text,
2. search for the functions of primary auxiliary verbs from the internet or text books,
3. individually write down sentences using each of the primary auxiliary verbs identified,
4. collaborate to write a short paragraph on environmental conservation using primary auxiliary verbs,
5. read out the paragraphs to the rest of the class,
6. fill in blank spaces in sentences given using the correct form of the primary auxiliary verbs,
7. engage in a question and answer session using primary auxiliary verbs.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 3.3.1 Word Classes: Primary Auxiliaries together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital literacy: It is promoted as the learner uses digital devices to search for information from the internet.

• Self-efficacy: It is affirmed as the learner’s confidence is boosted by using correct tenses in speech.

Values:
Respect: It is enhanced as the learner helps peers in constructing sentences correctly.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Environmental education awareness: It is enhanced as the learner writes a paragraph on environmental conservation.

Links to other Learning Areas:
The learner relates the concept of verbs to the learning of verbs in Kiswahili.
